highlights: Registration Jig has its own editor page: add text, import or trace artwork, then Save to canvas. Escape no longer discards your edits, and after the outline burn the jig switches to Artwork only and reminds you to refocus.

Centre & LED moves to the centre of your design and switches on a pointer light, optionally after a clean Frame. Marlin profiles that drive the laser from the fan output no longer offer a pointer light, so it can never fire the laser.

Find any command with Ctrl+K. The workspace is denser and fits smaller screens, the jog pad is more compact, dialogs keep their buttons visible, and the Settings window no longer changes size between sections.

Offset, Combine, Weld and Cut Shapes now run in the background so the app stays responsive. Cut Settings shows dither options as visual swatches, and the Material Test dialog previews its grid as you change it.

Jobs no longer hang when the controller's last replies are lost, and a working controller no longer raises reconnect pop-ups. Speed sliders use realistic ranges, and a clickable bed diagram sets the origin and homing corner.

Focus Test operations are clearly labelled, trim, node editing, shear and arrays are more accurate, paid licences keep checking in when the clock is wrong, and Electron is updated with the latest Chromium security fixes.
